summary: strftime formats a supported SQLite time value according to conversion codes.
documentation: strftime formats a supported SQLite time value according to conversion codes. With %Y-%m it returns a sortable year-month label, suitable for grouping explicit calendar dates by reporting period.
inputs: events(id INTEGER, occurred TEXT), containing valid YYYY-MM-DD dates or NULL.
returns: id and month_key, ordered by id.
caution: The returned month key is text, not a complete date. Timezone modifiers can change timestamp boundaries; this exercise supplies dates only and applies none.
scenarios: Attach reporting-month labels to imported event dates.
Build sortable month keys for a local archive.
Prepare monthly grouping fields without discarding the original dates.
title: Build calendar-month keys
problem: Return id and strftime('%Y-%m',occurred) AS month_key from events, ordered by id. NULL dates produce NULL.
hint: Use the four-digit year and two-digit month conversion codes.
goal: Use strftime() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
